welcome_message:
This app helps translate and manage in-game chat messages.
It was created to improve the game experience for players from different countries.
It is still in development and may contain some minor bugs. Released under the MIT license.
The application uses a free translation service (MyMemory) and does not interfere with the game code.
Check your preferences in the Settings tab.
Feel free to share your feedback about this program with me.
New in version 1.4.1:
- choose which chat channels are translated (Settings → Translated Channels),
- new project website: jacek-mar.github.io/star-conflict-chat-translator
